question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f8cb989ae4e399d7f38aa08010a450d4b3e115eea9c184de309bd815d89c5b.png] 

The revenue of the company in 2016 is by what percentage more than the average of the revenue in 2014, 2016 and 2018 (correct to the nearest integer)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The revenue of the company in 2016 = 340

The total number of the revenue in 2014, 2016 and 2018 = (260 + 340 + 375)

⇒ 975

Average revenue of company in 2014, 2016 and 2018 = (975/3)

⇒ 325

Required percentage = [(340 – 325)/325 × 100]

⇒ (15/325 × 100)

⇒ 4.61% ~ 5%

**∴ Required percentage is 5%**
